metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Edmund Hee: plan, git and feature panes beside the chat, and a plan-aware orchestrator for ralph-loop, and raven, an AI PM/CTO loop over Codex and Claude.

plugins.name: ralph-helper
plugins.description: Self-improving, plan-aware orchestrator for ralph-loop. Decomposes a plan into phases, injects unit tests, drives execution with test gating/rollback/regression checks, and learns per project via Obsidian memory + graphify search.

plugins.name: plan-tracker
plugins.description: Plan tracker pane: items of every approved plan, Claude marks them done, opus verifies each mark and audits every turn, leftovers of a plan turn are sent back to Claude on their own.

plugins.name: git-tracker
plugins.description: Git pane beside plan-tracker: the branch this one was cut from as git's own graph, changed and new files with +/- line counts, and the PR link once one exists.

plugins.name: feature-tracker
plugins.description: Features pane beside plan-tracker: the repo's modules and their features from a hand-editable features.md, an opus review per module (missing features, tech debt, missing handling, test gaps, security, improvements), each finding checked by a second opus pass, logged as checkbox notes in Obsidian or docs/features/, with each finding listed in the pane to pick and plan.

plugins.name: raven
plugins.description: AI PM/CTO loop: drop feature ideas, Codex drafts GitHub issues, Claude codes approved ones in a worktree, Codex reviews and ranks PRs and writes a lesson per fix; every agent call's tokens and Codex quota logged.
